verdict: Kinder Morgan's revenue rose 9% to $4.5B with growth in every pipeline segment, and net income rose 22% to $764M despite a $138M legal and environmental charge.

otherDetail: Net other expense of $97M in this chart: $231M of earnings from equity investments and $83M of operating other income, more than offset by $430M of net interest expense, partly cushioned by $19M of other income. Net income is the $764M attributable to Kinder Morgan, after $26M attributable to noncontrolling interests.
oneTimers: Certain Items cut $28M from adjusted earnings on a net basis: a $138M legal, environmental and other accrual (mainly in Products Pipelines) and $3M of risk-management losses, partly offset by a $71M gain on a divestiture and $42M of related tax benefits. Adjusted net income was $792M ($0.35 per share).
footerNote: Kinder Morgan reports operating income of $1,160M including $83M of 'Other income, net' inside its operating section; this chart shows that $83M below the operating line (in Other income), so operating income here is $1,077M — pre-tax income of $980M is unchanged. Segment revenues are external-customer revenues from the 10-Q, which sum to total revenue; segment totals including intersegment sales differ by a few million.

takeaways.title: Every segment grew
takeaways.text: Revenue rose to $4,531M from $4,146M. Natural gas transport volumes rose to 49,273 BBtu/d, and management credited favorable contributions across all business segments for the earnings growth.

takeaways.title: Profit rose 22% despite a charge
takeaways.text: Net income attributable to Kinder Morgan rose to $764M ($0.34 per share) from $628M, even after a $138M legal and environmental accrual. Adjusted EPS was $0.35.

takeaways.title: Free cash flow covered most of the dividend
takeaways.text: Free cash flow was $545M after $1,045M of capital spending; dividends paid were $665M, leaving FCF after dividends of -$120M for the quarter (positive $226M year to date).
